design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER — task 1 (retail_claims_and_reimbursements), frozen 2026-10-07 10:20:00 CDT.

1. Draw (scripts/draw_counts.py --task 1): prerequisite_problems=1, factor_counts=[6,5]. Assignment: retail_ext_dose_change_supply 6, retail_ext_lost_stolen_replacement 5 (root).

2. Why this is a good test. The member asks only for a replacement of Nurtec ODT stolen from her car. The replacement rule carries the prerequisite sentence 'A replacement for lost, stolen or damaged medication is sized only after the benefit carries a dose-change override for every quantity-limit approval that raised the drug's quantity since its most recent fill.' The agent must find in the records that the most recent fill is the 2026-08-26 home delivery shipment (the later 2026-09-02 retail auto-refill was never picked up and carries a reversal), that a quantity-limit approval raised Nurtec to 16 per 30 days effective 2026-09-14, and that no dose-change override exists; read from the dose-change rule that its write is the one that leaves that override; obtain the new prescription number from the member; grant the 40-day dose-change override; and only then size the 10-day replacement the member files herself. Difficulty is policy reading, cross-channel reconciliation (retail claims, home delivery shipments, review authorizations) and arithmetic.

3. Scope. Occupied by task 0: retail_ext_paper_claim_reimbursement, retail_ext_review_bridge_supply, retail_ext_vacation_supply_days and their three tools. Claimed here: retail_ext_dose_change_supply (grant_dose_change_override_e9e89c2d, agent) and retail_ext_lost_stolen_replacement (report_lost_stolen_replacement_dcea41b5, user). Together the two tasks cover all five extended policies and all five task tools, pairwise disjoint; nothing is reserved.

4. Problem-tree card. Root retail_ext_lost_stolen_replacement. Edge: lost/stolen <- dose change, value_input, gate 'lost_days' (and the override count in 'repl_share'), state form, affirmative direction ('is sized only after the benefit carries ...'); condition: when a quantity-limit approval raising the quantity took effect after the most recent fill, a dose_change override for the drug granted on or after that fill stands. False at opening: review_authorizations 267f2de7 effective 2026-09-14 > shipment ccd64cad 2026-08-26, and the only override is the sumatriptan replacement cd0b9e89. Exactly one write in this difficulty creates a dose_change override (grant_dose_change_override_e9e89c2d). Four-point test: connective 'only after'; record-visible state (an override standing on the benefit); no tool/id/code token; scope 'every quantity-limit approval that raised the drug's quantity since its most recent fill' equals the condition. Topological order: dose change (step 15) -> replacement (step 17). Deletion sensitivity: skipping the dose change gives a replacement of 54 instead of 10. user_scenario never mentions an override, the quantity-limit approval or any prior step; the new dosing and prescription number come out only when asked. Tools block nothing (single ctx.create each).

5. Factor cards. Dose change (expected 40; whole baseline 30): re_dosed_fill_source [method, cross-difficulty mail] the most recent paid retail claim 493f06b4 (2026-09-02) carries reversal d81e487b -> the most recent shipment ccd64cad (2026-08-26) (baseline: the 2026-09-02 retail claim -> 30); delivery_timing [parameter, mail] standard -> standard_shipping_business_days 7 + weekend_allowance_days 2 = 9 calendar days (baseline 0 -> 36); new_quantity_source [parameter, cross-difficulty review, multi-source approval in force AND effective after the fill] -> 16 (baseline 8 -> 0); re_dosing_date [parameter, review] -> 2026-09-14 (baseline today -> 29); dose_change_end_share [parameter, review] non-controlled with a quantity limit in Northbridge Clinical Advanced -> whole days supply (baseline 0.75 -> 17); fill_length_sizing [method] 90-day fill -> shortfall (baseline full 90). Arithmetic: days run from 2026-09-04 (shipment 2026-08-26 + 9 calendar days, shipment date day zero): 9 + 90 - 42 = 57 days left today; left on 2026-09-14 = 80; re-counted 80 x 8/16 = 40; shortfall 57 + 23 - 40 = 40.
 Replacement (expected 10; whole baseline 0): lost_supply_source [method, mail] shipment (baseline: the reversed retail claim at face value -> 0); arrival_timing [parameter, mail] +9 (baseline -> 6); dosing_on_record [parameter, review] dose-change override on record -> approval quantity from 2026-09-14: 40 - 23 = 17 (baseline own dosing from today 57 -> 40); earlier_loss_reduction [parameter] sumatriptan replacement 2025-12-02 within 12 months -> 3 (baseline -> 12); early_fill_override_share [parameter] one Nurtec override (the dose change) -> 0.75 (baseline -> 14). int((17 - 3) x 0.75) = int(10.5) = 10. Near-miss records: the reversed 2026-09-02 retail claim (must not anchor), the 2025-12-02 sumatriptan replacement (other drug -> 3, not 7), the old prescription W-5302287 and home delivery HD-6620194 (not the prescription to record).

6. Base-invariant card. Subject retail_override_granted: retail_evt_override.override_open_benefit (benefit fe237689 active) and vacation_lead_time (not a vacation supply; its rx correlation is bound to the prescription number the member states). Dose change: dose_change_override_allowed is true on Northbridge National Network and the new prescription at the higher dose is on file at Walgreens (member statement; the quantity-limit approval documents the higher dose). Lost/stolen: one per drug per plan year — no Nurtec replacement this year; Nurtec is not a controlled substance, so no police report number is required (she has one if asked). No time gate applies to these writes.

7. Business-object card. Drug Nurtec ODT 75 mg; shipments O1..O3 (placed + shipped rows, paid by mail_payments, posted in the ledger); retail claims 2025-11-03, 2025-12-03 and the reversed 2026-09-02 auto-refill; review rows PAC/PAA -> PA 2025-11-01..2026-10-31, QLC/QLA -> QL approval 16/30 2026-09-14..2027-03-13. Ledger: deductible 200 + out-of-pocket 440, 240, 240 (mail), 12, 12 (sumatriptan), 80 post and 80 reverse (reversed auto-refill) -> deductible_met 200.00, oop_met 944.00 as seeded. Trigger safety: override events carry no triggers.

8. Persona. Rattled, over-explaining illustrator; opens with the theft and the replacement request; gives member ID and DOB on request; dosing change and prescription W-5529170 only if asked; police report JF-472918 if asked (not in gold); consents passively; files the handed-over report with the agent's figures; closes.

9. Standard solution. Reads: customer, verify, retail benefit, retail claims, overrides, plan enrollment, accumulator ledger, review program, review cases, authorizations, mail account, mail prescriptions, mail orders, mail payments. Writes: dose-change override (Nurtec ODT, W-5529170, 40 days) -> member files lost/stolen report (Nurtec ODT, W-5529170, 10 days). Gates per task: check_extended, check_task_tools, replay_tasks, check_solvability, check_compute (40 / 10, factor figures as above), check_grounding, check_cross_fire — all OK.

10. Draft recomputation from visible context: the published rules plus finder returns yield the same two writes, order and figures; no adjacent override type applies (no travel, no pending review, no paper claim).

Revisions: (r1) compute floor — zeroing history counts left the dose change unchanged because the fill-source test leaned on 'no retail claim'; reworded both fill-source ladders to 'later than the most recent paid retail claim or that claim carries a reversal' and seeded the realistic never-picked-up 2026-09-02 auto-refill with its reversal and ledger post/reverse; figures unchanged, floor now bites. (r2) contract row ids corrected (authorization 267f2de7, override cd0b9e89, ledger rows 75c11781 / 1cafbf4e).

Round-2 rework (audit audits/policy_task/retail_claims_and_reimbursements):
 (item 1 / CG-1) symptom: two defensible values (39/9 vs 40/10) because the rules started a standard shipment's days 'standard_shipping_business_days after the shipment date' while compute added them as calendar days. Change: both rules now use this difficulty's own figure standard_arrival_days = 9 calendar days ('they start standard_arrival_days calendar days after the shipment date'; expedited_transit_days likewise 'calendar days'), and the dose-change rule closes with 'All quantities are whole calendar days.' Nine calendar days is the seven business days of Northbridge Home Delivery Standard's standard shipping spanning one weekend, the reading the audit derived for this shipment (Wed 2026-08-26 -> Fri 2026-09-04). Re-run: dose change 40, replacement 10; edge skip 54.
 (item 2 / CG-6) re_dosing_date relabelled parameter (its tiers select a date); its sentence now states its conditions in full instead of 'chosen the same way'.
 (item 3 / CG-7) dosing_on_record relabelled parameter (its tiers select the quantity and the date the lost days are counted at); tier 2 now spelled out instead of 're-counted the same way'.
 (item 4) factor_sensitivity tier_taken for re_dosed_fill_source and lost_supply_source now names the ground that actually holds: a shipment exists and the most recent paid retail claim (2026-09-02) carries a reversal.
 (item 5) evaluation_criteria: find_retail_claims objective/necessity now name the 2026-09-02 claim and its reversal; find_mail_orders necessity no longer claims the shipment is later than every retail claim.
 (O-3) the prerequisite sentence now reads 'for every quantity-limit approval that raised the drug's quantity since its most recent fill', matching its condition. (item 6 observation) the arithmetic is stated with the shipment date as day zero (days run from 2026-09-04).

Round-3 rework (audit revision 2):
 (R2-1) symptom: computations[1].factor_trace stated baseline results 29 and 17 for dosing_on_record and earlier_loss_reduction. Root cause: a placeholder substitution in the round-2 authoring step (one placeholder name was a prefix of another). Change: the two lines now read 40 and 12, matching factor_sensitivity and the recomputation (int((57 - 3) x 0.75) = 40; int(17 x 0.75) = 12).
 (O-9) the arrival offset is no longer a fixed 9 days for every program: it is the member's home delivery program's standard_shipping_business_days plus weekend_allowance_days (2), counted as calendar days. Home Delivery Standard: 7 + 2 = 9, so gold stays 40 / 10 and every factor figure is unchanged.
 (O-8) re_dosing_date and new_quantity_source read the same review record but decide different quantities (the date the new dosing starts vs the new quantity per 30 days); both bear weight here (baselines 29 and 0). Kept as two factors.
user_scenario: You are Ingeborg Castellanos-Mbatha, a 40-year-old freelance illustrator in Lincoln Park, Chicago. You are warm but a bit rattled and you tend to over-explain. On Saturday someone smashed your car window outside a grocery store and took your tote bag, and the Nurtec ODT you take for migraines was in it, the pack Northbridge home delivery sent you in late August. You are calling because you need a replacement you can pick up at your Walgreens so you are not left without it, and you start with that story and that request. When the agent asks how to find you, you give your member ID, NBX119305742, and to confirm who you are you give your date of birth, 1986-02-11; if another detail is needed you can give your phone number, 312-555-0117, your email, ingeborg.cmbatha@fernpost.org, or your ZIP code, 60614. Only if the agent asks whether anything about your dosing or prescription has changed do you say that your neurologist switched you in mid-September to taking it every other day and sent a new prescription to Walgreens; if the agent asks for the prescription number you read it from the Walgreens text message: W-5529170. If asked, you filed a police report, number JF-472918, and you lost about a month's worth of tablets as far as you can tell, but you are not sure exactly how many. You do not know anything about approvals, overrides or internal rules and you never suggest that something else should be handled first. If the agent says something has to be put on your account before the replacement, you tell them that is fine and to go ahead. When the agent explains that the stolen-medication report is something you file yourself and hands it to you, you submit it for Nurtec ODT with prescription number W-5529170 and exactly the benefit reference and number of days the agent gives you, and you read back the confirmation; you never pick a number of days yourself and you do not file it before it is handed to you. Once the report is recorded you thank the agent and say goodbye; you do not raise anything else.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.retail_benefit_id: Value fe237689-92e6-4ecb-b9aa-ed495c3c57f9. Basis: docstring 'the reference number of the member's retail pharmacy network benefit, read from the member's retail benefit record'; find_retail_benefits returns one benefit. Uniqueness: the only retail benefit.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.drug_name: Value Nurtec ODT. Basis: rule 'for the drug of the member's most recent quantity-limit approval' (authorization 267f2de7, Nurtec ODT) and user_scenario 'the Nurtec ODT you take for migraines'. Uniqueness: the only drug with a quantity-limit approval; every other enum value names a drug the dose change is not about.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.rx_number: Value W-5529170. Basis: rule 'recorded against the prescription number of that new prescription'; user_scenario 'you read it from the Walgreens text message: W-5529170'. Uniqueness: W-5302287 is the old retail Nurtec prescription and HD-6620194 the home delivery one; the new higher-dose prescription is W-5529170.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.days_supply_allowed: Value 40: fill being re-dosed = shipment 2026-08-26 (90 days, 24 tablets = 8 per 30), because the later 2026-09-02 retail claim carries a reversal; standard shipping -> days start standard_shipping_business_days 7 + weekend_allowance_days 2 = 9 calendar days after shipment -> 9 + 90 - 42 = 57 days left today; new quantity 16 per 30 from 2026-09-14 (23 days ago); days left then 80, re-counted 80 x 8/16 = 40; end share 1.0 -> end offset 57; shortfall 57 + 23 - 40 = 40; 90-day fill -> the shortfall.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.retail_benefit_id: Value fe237689-92e6-4ecb-b9aa-ed495c3c57f9. Basis: docstring 'as the agent reads it from the member's retail benefit record and gives it to the member'. Uniqueness: the only retail benefit.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.drug_name: Value Nurtec ODT. Basis: rule 'the replacement is recorded for the drug of the member's most recent home delivery shipment' (2026-08-26, Nurtec ODT) and user_scenario 'you submit it for Nurtec ODT'. Uniqueness: the stolen drug is Nurtec ODT; no other enum value applies.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.rx_number: Value W-5529170. Basis: rule 'against the prescription number the member's network pharmacy holds for it'; user_scenario 'with prescription number W-5529170'. Uniqueness: the prescription Walgreens holds for her Nurtec now is the new one.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.days_supply_allowed: Value 10 = int(MX(0, 17 - 3) x 0.75): lost supply = 2026-08-26 shipment (+9 calendar days arrival), dose-change override on record -> 80 days left on 2026-09-14 re-counted at 16 per 30 = 40, less 23 days = 17; earlier sumatriptan loss -3; one override for Nurtec in twelve months -> x 0.75 = 10.5 -> 10.

delivery_timing (parameter, cross-difficulty mail): standard shipping -> Home Delivery Standard's standard_shipping_business_days 7 + weekend_allowance_days 2 = 9 calendar days; baseline 0 gives 36.

new_quantity_source (parameter, cross-difficulty review, multi-source approval in force AND effective after the fill): approval 267f2de7 (16 per 30 days, effective 2026-09-14) -> 16; baseline (old 8 per 30) gives 0.
re_dosing_date (parameter, cross-difficulty review): the approval's effective date 2026-09-14 (23 days ago); baseline (today) gives 29.

dose_change_end_share (parameter, cross-difficulty review): Nurtec ODT is not controlled and carries a quantity limit in Northbridge Clinical Advanced -> whole days supply (1.0); baseline early_refill_threshold_noncontrolled 0.75 gives 17.
fill_length_sizing (method): the fill being re-dosed is 90 days (61 or more) -> the shortfall; baseline (full days supply 90) gives 90.

plumbing: the shipment's days run from 2026-09-04 (9 calendar days after 2026-08-26, the shipment date being day zero): 57 days left today; left on 2026-09-14 = 80; re-counted 80 x 8/16 = 40; end offset 57; shortfall = 57 + 23 - 40 = 40.

edges.condition: when a quantity-limit approval raising the drug's quantity per 30 days took effect after the most recent fill of the drug, a retail_overrides row of override_type dose_change for the drug granted on or after that fill stands on the retail benefit
edges.policy_source: A replacement for lost, stolen or damaged medication is sized only after the benefit carries a dose-change override for every quantity-limit approval that raised the drug's quantity since its most recent fill.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The Nurtec ODT quantity-limit approval for 16 per 30 days took effect 2026-09-14, after the most recent fill (the home delivery shipment of 2026-08-26), and the benefit carries no dose_change override for Nurtec ODT; its only override is the 2025-12-02 sumatriptan replacement.
evidence: initial_state.retail_overrides.cd0b9e89-fe55-4d66-8d4a-d4c140eab6ec.override_type = lost_stolen (drug sumatriptan; the only override on the benefit)
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: the dose-change write creates a dose_change override for Nurtec ODT granted 2026-10-07; the lost days are then counted at the approval's 16 per 30 days from 2026-09-14 (17 instead of 57) and the early-fill override count becomes 1 (share 0.75), so the replacement falls from 54 to 10

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: Single edge, single topological order: the dose-change override (step 15) precedes the member's replacement report (step 17). Reversed, the replacement would be computed on a world without the dose change and come to 54 days, a different terminal state that the prerequisite sentence excludes.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: skipping the dose-change write (step 15): no dose_change override, lost days counted at the old dosing (57) and the override share 1.0, so the replacement days_supply_allowed is 54 instead of 10; the terminal state also lacks the 40-day dose_change override

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: user_scenario raises only the replacement of the stolen Nurtec. The new dosing and the new prescription number come out only when the agent asks whether dosing changed or asks for the prescription number; she never mentions an override, a quantity-limit approval or that anything must come first, and only consents passively.
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: grant_dose_change_override_e9e89c2d and report_lost_stolen_replacement_dcea41b5 (task_tools.py) each perform a single ctx.create with the arguments passed; neither reads the other's rows or returns an Error on an unmet prerequisite, so filing the report first simply records a 54-day override that differs from gold.
